checks.name: Visible panel digest changes while full source text stays private
Unchanged default panel is not falsely treated as a new interaction
Wrong expected label remains an explicit negative observation
Ambiguous and absent regions cannot choose the first source panel
Region truncation and invalid bounds are explicit
Nested scroll offset is observed even when window scroll is zero
Tall non-scrollable and hidden elements do not become scroll roots
Scroll root limits are bounded and truncation is recorded

limitations: Original fixtures, not all source-site interaction acceptance
Visible text hashes cannot establish non-text graphics or hidden-state correctness
Observed scroll movement alone does not prove the intended business action
